Without this coefficient the reader cannot check that the side term cancels the central coefficient (-1/2 for intersection zero, 1/2 for intersection two) or that the self coefficient is 1.

gaps.note: The page does not say that stage j fixes the other two coordinates of a and varies the j-th coordinate (paper line 670-672). So the reader cannot see why each stage has v^2 invocations, why each invocation acts on a bank slice, or why the three stages give (X_a,Y_a) to (-Y_a,X_a) for every a.
